---
title: "Normalverteilung"
params:
  lang: de
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

task <- "lpnorm"
rolog::consult(system.file("rexams/lpnorm.pl", package="mistakes"))

hook(pvalue(.P), .P)
hook(pnorm1(.X, .Tail), pnorm(.X, .Tail))
hook(sigma2, sigma^2L)

dist <- function(Symb, X, Tail)
  return(X)

tail <- function(Tail)
  return(Tail)

pnorm1 <- function(C, Tail)
{
  if(Tail == "lower")
    return(pnorm(C, lower.tail=TRUE))

  if(Tail == "upper")
    return(pnorm(C, lower.tail=FALSE))

  stop("Tail must bei either upper or lower")
}

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  mu     <- round(runif(1, min=-10, max=10), 1)
  sigma  <- round(runif(1, min=5, max=25), 1)
  p      <- round(runif(1, min=0.1, max=0.9), 1)
  C      <- round(qnorm(p, mean=mu, sd=sigma), 1)
  
  Q <- quote(search(lpnorm, lpnorm(C, mu, sigma^2L), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next
  # Todo: several incorrect solutions match to < 0.001 and 1. Collapse into
  # one option, and collect feedback for all of them.
  # if(any(duplicated(R)))
  #   next

  # Todo: Local definition of user:math_hook/2 overrides weak import from mathml
  # Todo: copy to upnorm
  break
}


t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(
  t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra
)
```

Question
========
Wir betrachten die Normalverteilung $\mu = `r sprintf("%.1f", mu)`$, $\sigma^2 =`r sprintf("%.1f", sigma^2)`$. 

Wie viele Realisierungen liegen unter $`r sprintf("%.1f", C)`$?

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Lösung
========
Der Anteil wird berechnet durch: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
